lines: "Say you wanted to test it. What would you even look for?"
"Nothing. That's my whole objection. Any evidence you find, the theory eats. Rain? Simulated. No rain? Simulated. A guess that can't be wrong isn't worth having."
"You notice the ones that land and forget the thousand that didn't. Run into me twice in a week and it's fate. The other five days I wasn't here at all."
"I'm cheap company and I'm right. Take one."
